</think>
<plan>

</plan>
<action type="say">
For a 9:00 a.m. hearing in downtown DC:

- DCA → downtown: about 20–40 minutes.
- IAD/BWI → downtown: often 60–90+ minutes.

To have a reasonable safety margin, you should plan to be:

- At DCA by about 6:30–7:00 a.m. at the latest, or
- At IAD/BWI by about 6:00–6:30 a.m. at the latest.

Given that:

1) Best timing
- Safest option: Fly in TONIGHT and stay near downtown or near DCA. That avoids same‑day flight risk before court.
- Second‑best: A very early flight tomorrow that lands:
  - At DCA no later than ~6:30–7:00 a.m.
  - At IAD/BWI no later than ~6:00–6:30 a.m.

2) What to say to United (phone/app/chat)
Use something like this:

“My flight UA892 SFO–DCA on 2025-09-18 was cancelled due to weather. I have a court hearing tomorrow at 9:00 a.m. in downtown Washington, DC. I can leave tonight or very early tomorrow, but I must arrive in the DC area by about 6:30–7:00 a.m. local time (earlier if you can only get me into IAD or BWI). Please rebook me on the earliest possible option to DCA, or if necessary to IAD or BWI, with fees and fare differences waived since my original flight was cancelled.”

Ask them specifically to:
- Check all DC‑area airports: DCA first, then IAD or BWI.
- Look at late‑evening/red‑eye flights tonight and first‑wave arrivals tomorrow morning.

3) How to judge any options they offer
- For DCA: arrival by 7:00 a.m. is generally acceptable.
- For IAD/BWI: push for arrivals by 6:00–6:30 a.m. to leave enough time for the longer ground trip.

If you tell me the exact options United offers you (airport + arrival time), I can quickly tell you which ones are realistically safe for making your 9:00 a.m. hearing and which are too risky.</action>

<action type="say">
For reliably making a 9:00 a.m. hearing downtown, the IAD option (arriving 6:05 a.m.) is safer.

Reasoning:

- IAD → downtown (Option 1, arrive 6:05 a.m.):  
  - Off the plane and out of the airport: ~20–30 minutes if normal.  
  - Drive to downtown at that hour: ~45–60 minutes.  
  - Realistic arrival downtown: roughly 7:15–7:45 a.m. — you still have meaningful buffer before 9:00 a.m.

- DCA → downtown (Option 2, arrive 7:35 a.m.):  
  - Off the plane and out: ~15–20 minutes if smooth.  
  - Drive to downtown: 20–30 minutes.  
  - Best‑case downtown arrival: about 8:10–8:25 a.m. with very little margin. Any minor delay (late arrival, slow deplaning, ride‑share wait, traffic) can push you too close to or past 9:00 a.m.

So:  
- Choose Option 1 (SFO → IAD, arrive 6:05 a.m.).  
- On landing, head straight to a taxi/ride‑share; tell the driver you must be at your courthouse by around 8:30 a.m. at the latest so they understand it’s time‑sensitive.

If you share which courthouse you’re going to, I can sanity‑check the ground timing and suggest the best drop‑off window.</action>
